jobDescription: Swiss Re is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our internal Data Platform. You will define the product vision for self-serve data access, partner with data engineering and actuarial teams, and drive adoption of governed data products across the organization. We are looking for someone with strong stakeholder management, a data-driven approach to prioritization, experience with B2B or internal enterprise platforms, and the ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into clear roadmaps. Experience with SQL, analytics tooling, API/platform product management, and OKRs is expected. German is a plus.
nextAction: Prepare case study for panel round
coverLetter:
Dear Swiss Re Hiring Team,

Internal data platforms succeed when the governed path is also the easiest path. That belief has shaped my last eight years in B2B SaaS, most recently at Yokoy, where I led the analytics product area and grew governed self-serve usage from 12% to 68% of all queries within a year.

The Senior Product Manager role on your Data Platform is a natural next step. I have partnered with data engineering and finance teams to translate compliance requirements into roadmaps people actually adopt, set OKRs that measure outcomes rather than output, and used SQL and analytics tooling daily to make prioritisation calls I can defend.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could help Swiss Re's teams get more value from governed data products.

Mit freundlichen Grüssen,
Maya Schneider
